obfuscation_indicators: other risks detailed from time to time
risk_summary: The disclosure provides meaningful quantitative detail on billings, geographic concentration, pandemic-related declines, customer additions, and substantial operating losses. However, it relies heavily on standard forward-looking disclaimers and optimistic, largely unquantified claims regarding technology, customer growth, blockchain benefits, and future operations. Credit risk is elevated by recurring operating losses, concentration in California and hospitality-related customers, pandemic sensitivity, and reliance on successful technology and acquisition execution.
